title: A failed command, a saved correction, and the next run

voice.name: Emma
voice.processing: Fixed gain and scheduled silence; no time stretching or pitch change

beats.title: One wrong flag
beats.text: The Harbour brief needs checking. In a real coding session, the agent uses a misspelled flag. The validator fails, with exit code two.

beats.title: Keep the failure that happened
beats.text: The project adapter passes that actual tool result to Terraphim. A saved learning now contains the command and its error.

beats.title: Review, then promote
beats.text: I record the correction and explicitly promote it to a tool preference. Compilation produces one rule. This review step matters: a captured failure alone does not activate a replacement.

beats.title: Hook output is not execution
beats.text: Without rewriting, the hook keeps the typo and warns. With rewriting enabled, it returns the corrected command. This JSON has not executed anything yet.

beats.title: A fresh host run applies it
beats.text: A new coding session tries the same typo. The included OpenCode adapter applies the returned command. The real tool event now records the correct flag and exit code zero.

beats.title: Inspect the result on disk
beats.text: The validator writes this result file. Unrelated commands and an unrelated role remain unchanged. These are actual outputs from the released binary.

beats.title: Try the public fixture
beats.text: Download the brief, adapter, saved traces and reproduction script. Follow one reviewed correction all the way from failure to a command that actually runs.
